OrmanKZ is an application for viewing and working with mobile maps of forests on your smartphones and tablets.
Full-fledged work with the map does not require the Internet, and all of the application tools are available even in offline mode. Get directions, save routes, mark the economic areas where changes have occurred, find out information about blocks, allotments, and tax characteristics on the map. OrmanKZ is a multi-functional navigation app with a large selection of map sources to choose from: satellite, topographic, marine, and many other basic maps.
The app is ideal for planning routes, allotments, and also for working with full-scale forest taxation. it can also be used as a tool for measuring and calculating areas and distances.


Features of OrmanKZ:

• Gallery of free offline maps
• Support for various coordinate systems
• Maps are created and edited, there is a possibility of ordering your own map
• Detection of current location with GPS/GLONASS
• Recording GPS tracks in motion. Note that long use of GPS in the background significantly affects the life time of your device battery!
• Adding objects to map as points, lines, polygons
• Filling in attribute data using QR code
• Attaching media files to objects
• Searching and identification of objects
• Measuring distances and areas
• Import and export of data in GPKG/GPX/KML/KMZ/SHP formats
• Sharing collected data
• Saving selected map areas as bookmarks for quicker access
• Printing selected map areas
• Support for external Bad Elf GPS receivers
• Using map objects as destination points
• Searching by name, address, category and coordinates.

OrmanKZ allows to simplify the data collection process via predefined templates and provides options to create new layers and share collected data with friends or colleagues. With OrmanKZ you will be able to edit the created point, polyline, and polygon objects and add new attributes to them.

Today, OrmanKZ is successfully utilized not only by tourists and travelers, but also by specialists from housing and utility, water and land resources management, ecology and incident management, urban management, and many other areas worldwide.
OrmanKZ mobile maps are created by extracting Esri ArcGIS map documents into a custom mobile format (CMF2) using the CarryMap Builder plug-in for ArcGIS Desktop. 

To learn more about CarryMap Builder extension, visit https://builder.carrymap.com.
